<!--
Before filing:
- Search open issues and Discussions > Ideas first.
- Half-formed ideas are welcome in Discussions > Ideas. Use this template when you
  can describe a concrete change.
- InBrowser has no backend and no account system by design. Proposals that require
  a server to hold user data will not be built, so if yours seems to, say how it
  could work client-side.
-->

## The problem

<!-- What are you trying to do, and what stops you today?
     Describe the situation, not the solution. This is the part that gets read most carefully. -->

## What you do instead today

<!-- The workaround, even if it is "give up and use something else". This says a lot about
     how much the gap costs. -->

## What you are proposing

<!-- The change, concretely. Where it would live in the UI, what it would do. -->

## Which part of the app

<!-- Delete the ones that do not apply. -->

Chat / Local models (WebGPU) / Hosted providers / Code runtimes / Agents / Skills /
Memory / Scheduled tasks / Web search / File and document handling / Image, video, audio /
Import and export / PWA and offline / Proxy relay / Self-hosting / UI and theming

## Alternatives you considered

<!-- Including doing nothing, or solving it with an Agent Skill instead of a core feature.
     Many requests are better as a skill: it ships faster and does not grow the bundle. -->

## Does it fit the constraints

- [ ] Works client-side, with no backend and no account
- [ ] Nothing leaves the browser that does not already
- [ ] Does not require a paid or key-only service to be useful
- [ ] Meaningfully bounded in download size <!-- runtimes and models are already ~311 MB of dist/ -->

<!-- If you ticked fewer than four, explain the trade-off rather than dropping the request.
     Some are worth it. -->

<!-- Pick one: nice to have / would use it weekly / blocking me from using InBrowser -->
